scope: Reviewed actual power and selected-column copper contract, including all preserved narrow sections. Exact geometry protects deliberate wide feeds. Models are not measured qualification.

feed_review.transit: VCC2mm F crossbar x1.9..38.3 at y1.2mm. Four0.6/0.3mm ordinary vias at each end join left B1.2mm and right In2 2mm feed. Right rear rail would collide with the human row-resistor bank, so its explicit2mm In2 path is deliberate. Solid native contacts retain both VCC pins per side.
feed_review.local_P_sources: B1mm left trunk x3.04 y3..39.266mm,0.5mm B branches directly to each Q1..Q8 source. One selected PMOS feeds up to eight LED currents; selected-column /S tracks are widened to0.3/0.4/0.5mm where clearance permits outside In1.
feed_review.local_ground: N-MOS source branches carry one LED current each; broad main In1 GND carries sum. Two isolated gateway regions receive B0.5mm bridges. Main-ground DC sheet model is separate.
feed_review.capacitors: C1 retains short direct VCC tie to U2.16. Added supply gateway atC3 VCC(22.561,27.8),0.5mm B/F feed to main In2 at(18.377,26.808). A0.4mm direct B route joins C4 VCC to that gateway rather than relying on the detour through U1.9. C4 GND ordinary via moved0.1mm away fromSMD land. Physical transient loops remain unmeasured.
feed_review.operating_plan: Five tiles, external3.3V±5%, conservative0.5Apeak/tile. Feed both ends from the SAME regulated supply. Connector/contact drops, peak rails, pulse widths, temperatures and actual current require measurement.
